provenance.author: PAGODI
provenance.relationship: Third-party community resource pack by PAGODI; not the Verity mod author VarmiteYT and not a replacement Verity JAR.

translation.language: Only assets/verity/lang/ru_ru.json; no English locale in added pack.
translation.coverageLimit: This archive is a 29-key language layer. It cannot translate Java-coded screens/dialogue/voice and does not replace the approved fuller Russian binary translation. Some new keys are legacy/config aliases; their appearance in the file is not proof of a current UI caller.
translation.changedNameChoice: The author layer changes several localized proper-name values from Verity to Истина. These are resource-level labels in Russian; Java-coded dialogue remains the approved derivative.
translation.nonVerityKey: minecraft:key.categories.multiplayer (literal key string in the verity resource namespace; no key registration)

exactMethods: KubeJSPaths.<clinit>: ASSETS = DIRECTORY.resolve("assets"), DIRECTORY is game/kubejs
MinecraftClientMixin.kjs$loadPacks(List): existing ModifyExpressionValue on constructor and reloadResourcePacks(Z), PackRepository.openAllSelected() result -> GeneratedClientResourcePack.inject

GeneratedClientResourcePack.inject(Minecraft,List): copies existing list, scans kubejs/assets top-level .zip files, creates native FilePackResources(name,file,false), inserts alongside generated KubeJS assets
activation.nativePriority: Insertion boundary is the first FilePackResources (ZIP) from index1; otherwise end of selected list. Selected ZIP packs after that boundary keep priority. Directory packs represented by PathPackResources are not recognized by this boundary: do not promise universal personal-directory-pack precedence. No personal selection/order file is rewritten.
activation.sourceRestore: Support resource must be committed in Git and verified before restore_modified; restore does not download missing support files. Current .gitignore does not ignore kubejs/assets/*.zip; git check-ignore returned1. * -text keeps byte content.

nativeProof.limits: Standalone native serializer/resource/language process; not a full client/Mixin/pixel/runtime acceptance.

safety.reason: Three data-only client-resource entries: localized strings, pack metadata and selection icon. No classes, scripts, server data, registry or world/inventory mutation paths.
